s.note: the medieval battle game in the park
s.how: Rub 12 chicken drumsticks with oil, salt, garlic and rosemary and roast at 200C for 40 minutes until golden. Serve straight away on a big platter in the middle of the table.
Pop 100g popcorn kernels and toss with butter and salt. Mix with 150g pretzels and 200g mixed lollies and portion into paper bags. Serve straight away on a big platter in the middle of the table.

m.how: Shape 800g beef mince into 4 patties, grill and top with cheese. Build in 4 buns with pickles and sauce and serve with 1kg oven fries.

w.how: Melt 125g butter with 150g honey, mix in 2 eggs, 200g self-raising flour and 1 tsp mixed spice. Bake in 12 muffin holes at 175C for 18 minutes.

d.note: the Minotaur energy drink they sell
d.how: Mix the juice of 4 lemons and 2 limes with 4 tbsp sugar and a knob of grated ginger. Strain and top with 1L soda water over ice.
